out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The health department permit must be posted where customers can see it. The PIC could not locate the permit.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Locate the permit or obtain a new one by contacting the health department office at 703-246-2201. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed an employee dumping the wiping cloth sanitizer bucket solution in the handsink next to the warewashing sinks.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The EHS discussed this with the PIC who discussed it with the employee.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Observed the hot water dish washing machine final rinse temperature was below 160º. The machine was cycled three times with temperatures of 150º all three times.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. The sanitizing rinse temperature of the of the dish machine must be checked frequently to ensure it is working properly.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Obtain an irreversible registering thermometer or heat tapes to check the final rinse temperature of the dishmachine. Correct as soon as possible or within 10 days. Follow-up is required for this and will occur on Thursday, August 6, 2026.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIA solution was measured at >500ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of QUATERNARY AMMONIA solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: WATER ADDED TO DILUTE SANITIZER SOLUTION DURING INSPECTION. FINAL READING WAS ~400PPM QUAT.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS IN SANITIZER BUCKETS AT ~10PPM CHLORINE.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: BUCKETS DUMPED AND FILLED WITH ~50PPM CHLORINE SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution was measured at 500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonia solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM DILUTED SANITIZER TO 400ppm AND EDUCATED EMPLOYEES ABOUT DILUTING THE SANITIZER
